missions.query: Which products are at risk of stockout this week?

missions.name: Missing Sales Records
missions.query: SELECT * FROM shop_sales WHERE date IS NULL OR transaction_id IS NULL

missions.name: Inconsistent Product Prices
missions.query: SELECT product, retail_price FROM products WHERE retail_price IS NOT NULL AND retail_price < unit_cost

missions.name: Unaccounted Inventory
missions.query: SELECT sku, location, stock_count FROM inventory WHERE stock_count IS NOT NULL AND stock_count < reorder_point

missions.name: Missing Supplier Information
missions.query: SELECT * FROM products WHERE supplier_id IS NULL OR supplier_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM suppliers)

missions.name: Unreconciled Sales and Inventory
missions.query: SELECT product, category, quantity, price, cost FROM shop_sales s JOIN products p ON s.product = p.sku WHERE s.quantity * s.price - s.cost > (SELECT SUM(stock_count * unit_cost) FROM inventory WHERE sku = s.product)

missions.name: Discount Abuse
missions.query: SELECT product, category, quantity, discount_pct FROM shop_sales WHERE discount_pct > 20

missions.name: Payment Method Discrepancy
missions.query: SELECT payment_method, count(*) as count FROM shop_sales GROUP BY payment_method HAVING count(*) > 5

missions.name: Inconsistent Restocking Dates
missions.query: SELECT sku, location, last_restocked_at FROM inventory WHERE last_restocked_at IS NOT NULL AND last_restocked_at < (SELECT MIN(last_restocked_at) FROM inventory)
